selection_rationale: Candidate cand-2026-003 (Automated provenance/evidence-scoring judge) is selected because it best matches available compute/model-call constraints (lower estimated model calls), has high venue relevance and novelty, and its remaining design repairs (annotation protocol, retrieval/telemetry specifications, and preregistered judge rules) are concrete and tractable within the project budget. Key supporting records: https://openalex.org/W7136127232, https://openalex.org/W4413283185, https://openalex.org/W7117986201, https://openalex.org/W4403635865.
unresolved_uncertainties: Availability and snapshot integrity of telemetry sources for reliable cross-checking of "no-issue" assertions
Noise and inter-annotator reliability when labeling subtle 'no-issue'/hallucination cases
Generalization of the judge to out-of-distribution diagnostics and unseen telemetry/retrieval corpora
Operational availability of retrieval/indexing resources and deterministic indexing parameters for reproducible scoring
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Provide detailed annotation protocol for the 600-item dataset: inclusion/exclusion rules, labeling rubric, annotator qualifications, adjudication rules, and target inter-annotator agreement (e.g., Cohen's kappa target).

Specify retrieval corpus precisely: sources, snapshot dates, indexing pipeline, embedding/retrieval models, similarity metrics, deterministic seeds, and reproducible index build scripts (publishable).
Define telemetry cross-check procedures: available metrics, collection windows, normalization, feature extraction, and deterministic matching logic used by judge.
Fully specify validator checks (syntactic and semantic): formal property list, code repo or pseudocode, expected failure modes, and coverage analysis.
Preregister judge design: rule-based baseline, classifier architecture (if used), hyperparameters, training/validation/test splits, random seeds, thresholds, and ablation plan.
Freeze evaluation protocol: gold labeling process, train/validation/test split, bootstrap/CI methods, decision thresholds to be reported, and exact primary outcome metric (judge F1 with 95% CI).

Publish dataset and code artifacts (or data generation scripts) required to reproduce experiments: prompts, LLM model identifiers, prompt templates, retrieval/indexing code, validator code, judge code, and execution logs (or hashes).
Define and preregister failure criteria and acceptable operational thresholds (precision/recall trade-offs) and a sensitivity analysis plan for missing provenance/telemetry signals.
